args.message: Revenue bands for the 201 customers with at least one order. Each customer's revenue is the sum of all their order amounts, with no filter on order status. 61 customers fall in the 0 band (under 1000), 68 in the 1000 band, 49 in the 2000 band and 23 in the 3000 band (3000 or more). I left out 6 orders that have no customer ID, since they can't be assigned to anyone; counted together they would have added a 62nd entry to the 0 band. Every remaining customer ID matches a record in the customers table.
